title: Walking in 3D
description:
Move a first-person player on the ground with WASD and a facing angle.

```
facing 0 (looking down -Z), press W 1 s at 5 m/s -> (0, 0, -5)
facing 90, press W -> moves along +X
W and D together -> same speed as W alone (normalised)
```
hints: With yaw 0 looking down -Z: forward = `(sin(yaw), 0, -cos(yaw))` and right = `(cos(yaw), 0, sin(yaw))` (lesson 5.02).
Add up the vectors for the pressed keys, then divide by the length if it is above 0.
requirements: Forward and right vectors from the yaw angle, on the XZ plane only.
Combine pressed keys into one direction and normalise it.
Turning with the mouse changes the yaw; the pitch only changes the view, not walking.
stretch: Add jumping and gravity on the Y axis.
